name: Guaningala Scoundrel (CR 1/2)
body:
GUANINGALA SCOUNDREL
CR 1/2

This strange humanoid is dressed in colorful leather armor. It has smooth green skin and large black eyes. It is bald except for tufts of hair on its cheeks. Two large teeth, reminiscent of walrus tusks, dominate its face, jutting down from its upper jaw.

XP 200
Guaningala fighter 1
NE Medium humanoid (guaningala)
Init +1; Senses low-light vision; Perception +0

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 11, flat-footed 14 (+1 Dex, +4 armor)
hp 15 (1d10+4+1)
Fort +6, Ref +1, Will +0

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee halberd +3 (1d10+3/×3 P or S; brace, trip) or dagger +3 (1d4+2 P or S, 19-20/×2)
Ranged light crossbow +2 (1d8 P, 19-20/×2, range incr. 80 ft.; AP 1) or dagger +2 (1d4+2 P or S, 19-20/×2, range incr. 10 ft.)

STATISTICS

Str 15, Dex 12, Con 18, Int 8, Wis 11, Cha 6
Base Atk +1; CMB +3; CMD 14
Feats Intimidating Prowess, Power Attack, Rapid Reload (light crossbow)
Skills Intimidate +5, Survival +4, Swim +4; Species Modifiers +4 Survival, +4 Swim
Languages Common, Guaningala
SQ amphibious, subspecies (kuyaran)
Gear NPC gear (leather laminar, dagger, halberd, light crossbow with 10 bolts, other gear)

ABOUT

Guaningala scoundrels can be found throughout the Galaxy, taking odd jobs for various criminal organizations in order to get by. Some guaningalas are even ambitious enough to initiate their own criminal schemes, but few have enough common sense to pull off anything more than simple smash-and-grab plans. Although they are not good at being subtle, they are tough and reasonably good at providing muscle when called on.
